Name: MiniMax H3
Tagline: Unified video generation for motion design and branding
Description: MiniMax H3 is an open multimodal model that generates 2K video with native stereo sound. It unifies text, image, and audio inputs, excelling at accurate text rendering, visual packaging, and complex instruction following for commercial content creation.

Name: Poth Labs
Tagline: The customer brain for your company
Description: Customer knowledge isn't a collection of documents. It's a network of relationships. Poth builds a living model of your customers before answering questions, so Ask Poth can reason across all your company knows instead of summarizing isolated sources. That unlocks questions no single source can answer, from what's driving churn to why customers adopt or abandon features. Every conclusion is grounded in evidence. If the answer isn't there, Poth launches adaptive surveys to collect what's missing.

Name: Halo by Scam AI
Tagline: Know who’s real on every video call
Description: The person on your next video call might not be real. With Halo you don't have to guess. Halo secures your Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet call live and flags synthetic faces the moment it detects one, entirely on your device. Deepfake video calls are already being used to scam people and businesses around the world, it's just that most people have no way to tell. From confirming who you're hiring to confirming who you're wiring money to, Halo catches it before it costs you.

Name: Cleanlist AI
Tagline: Natural-language prospecting: find, enrich and sync leads.
Description: Cleanlist AI turns any prospecting input into a verified, enriched, CRM-ready lead list. Upload a CSV, paste LinkedIn or Sales Navigator URLs, add domains, or use search filters, then let AI agents enrich contacts, verify emails, research each lead, and sync the final list to your CRM. With a 15-provider enrichment waterfall, AI research columns, and one-click CRM sync, Cleanlist helps GTM teams build lists without stitching together six tools.

Name: mectrics
Tagline: Your Mac's vitals in the menu bar. Free and open source.
Topics: Mac, Open Source, Menu Bar Apps
Description: CPU, memory, battery, network, disk, GPU, temperature and fans in your menu bar. You pick which ones show, and a click opens the detail behind it. Compact Health folds the whole machine into one item that stays quiet until something's off. MIT, macOS 15+.

Name: Customer.io Summer Release
Tagline: New ways to reach customers in the moments that matter
Description: Customer.io's most expansive launch yet brings powerful new ways to engage customers exactly when it matters across expanded triggers, surfaces, and channels. Reach customers with geofencing, Live Notifications, flexible SMS providers, notification inbox, and beyond. Improved WhatsApp management, smarter AI, and more, all from one platform.

Name: DepthData
Tagline: The system of record for your company's AI spend.
Description: Companies now pay for four or five AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and more) but can't answer the basics: what are we spending, who's using it, and which seats sit idle? DepthData connects every AI tool into one audit ready view of spend and adoption. What makes it different: every number is labeled by how it's verified, we never read prompts, and we show exactly what each vendor's API can and can't expose. The trusted system of record for your company's AI spend.

Name: Screencap
Tagline: Turn your team's real workflows into AI training data
Description: Screencap records how work actually happens: screen, clicks, keystrokes, window context and teams can use it to turn real workflows into structured datasets for automation and AI training. Consent and privacy are enforced while recording so most sensitive apps are blocked before anything is written, and every trace is scrubbed and reviewed before it leaves a machine. macOS, open source. Try it solo with a free trial, or talk to us about a team pilot.

Name: witr
Tagline: Why is this running? Trace process, port, container or file
Topics: Linux, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: ps, top and lsof tell you what is running. witr tells you why. Point it at a process, PID, port, container or file and it traces the chain that explains it - systemd, supervisor, shell or cron - plus who started it, when, from where, and the warnings worth knowing. Run it bare for an interactive TUI with Processes, Ports, Containers and Locks tabs. Or script it: --short for a one-line chain, --json with real exit codes. One static Go binary for Linux, macOS, Windows and BSD.

Name: Mubert API
Tagline: Edit tracks & stems, get consistent music with new engine
Description: Meet the new Mubert API. Edit tracks, swap stems, and generate more consistent music with our latest engine. Create tracks up to 2 hours long, stream music in real time, and integrate Mubert into your pipeline in minutes with Skills.

Name: TraceLLM
Tagline: OpenTelemetry for production AI applications
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Tech
Description: Tracellm is an observability platform for production AI applications. Monitor prompt execution, token consumption, latency, spans, errors, and model calls across your LLM workflows. Export traces using OpenTelemetry (OTLP) and quickly identify bottlenecks before they impact users

Name: Gemini Robotics 2
Tagline: Google's AI brain for the next generation of robots
Description: Gemini Robotics 2 is Google DeepMind’s latest step toward intelligent robots that can understand, reason, and act in the physical world. Powered by advanced Gemini models, it brings whole-body intelligence, dexterous manipulation, and adaptive reasoning to robots of different shapes and sizes. From complex physical tasks to multi-robot collaboration, Gemini Robotics 2 moves us closer to a future where robots can work alongside humans.

Name: Polygres
Tagline: Turn your entire database into a context window for AI
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Database
Description: Polygres turns Postgres into working memory for AI agents. Retrieve structured rows, connected relationships, semantic matches, and full-text results through one hybrid API. All without a separate vector store, graph database, or sync pipeline. Build grounded agents over the data you already have, with relational, graph, and vector context joined at the source. Use the managed cloud or self-host with our open source components. Polygres is currently free to use, just sign up!

Name: VulX Watch
Tagline: Vibe-code freely. We watch your back
Description: The AI that built your app can't verify its own work. VulX Watch can, connect a GitHub repo and it independently reviews what your AI actually shipped, shows you what's vulnerable, and backs every finding with the evidence and the exact line. Read-only, never touches your code, free to try. Keep building fast, and let something independent certify what you made.

Name: Nommer.ai
Tagline: Turn any recipe into 2-player mode
Description: Nommer turns any recipe into 2-player mode so you can cook together with ease. The core of the app is a unique cooking interface that splits a recipe into steps for each chef; one might do the onion cutting prep while the other creates a sauce for instance. At the final step, everything always comes together as a team. Unlike other recipe apps, you can import and cook as many recipes as you want; you only spend credits when you cook together with another chef.

Name: allmodels.io
Tagline: OpenRouter for Audio
Description: Openrouter for Speech AI. Route text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and realtime voice models through one API. Compare providers, latency, pricing, and capabilities with AllModels.

Name: Remove Excel blank row,even millions row
Tagline: Excel Data Cleaner — Remove Millions of Empty Rows Fast
Description: Key features: ✅ Remove empty rows at the bottom of Excel files Clean up unused rows that make your worksheet huge or difficult to manage. ✅ Remove blank rows between data Keep your data structure clean without manually selecting rows one by one. ✅ Process large Excel files Designed for large datasets, including files with millions of rows. ✅ Customize blank row rules Define your own conditions to decide which rows should be removed ✅ Fast batch cleaning No repetitive clicking.Done with one-click

Name: BackdropKit
Tagline: Launch-ready screenshots and demo videos private by design
Description: BackdropKit turns a raw product screenshot or demo video into a complete launch kit without sending it anywhere. Add or generate backgrounds, spotlight and call out UI, redact sensitive text, and export channel-sized images, video, GIF, thumbnail, post copy, and alt text. Everything runs locally in your browser—free, private, and watermark-free.

Name: Flickstrike
Tagline: Competitive launch football built around angles and power
Description: I wanted a video game that played like soccer, where passing and shooting take real skill and practice. Flickstrike is a free browser game built around angles, power, positioning, and bank shots. You control the whole team, so you can set up every pass and shot without relying on a teammate. Play 6v6 or 4v4 online, challenge bots, create formations, and train with skill drills.

Name: Clavio
Tagline: Vault, Memory, Agent and Code Briedge
Description: Hosted credential vault with envelope encryption, hybrid Agent Memory search, four MCP surfaces (Vault, Memory, Agent, Code Bridge), WordPress/DB/mail tools, and audit on every access. Start free.
